sources.title: Asure 12B original model card, pinned
sources.evidence: Names this exact 12B multimodal instruct release, trained for Turkish and English e-commerce tasks, based on Gemma 3 12B. Explicitly declares license: gemma. The 12B figure is nominal, and no separate active count or reasoning/tool mode is defined. Fresh October 27 re-read confirms metadata base_model=google/gemma-3-12b, explicit Gemma 3-12B ancestry, instruction-format training and native use of Gemma 3 multimodal capabilities. Lower token consumption is described as reduced verbosity, not structural compression.

sources.title: Asure 12B released configuration, pinned
sources.evidence: Gemma3ForConditionalGeneration, Transformers 4.57.3; dense 48-layer Gemma3 text decoder, hidden size 3840, intermediate size 15360, 16 query/8 KV heads of dimension 256, vocabulary 262208, 131072 context. SigLIP vision tower: width 1152, 27 layers, intermediate 4304, 896x896 input with 14x14 patches; vision_use_head=false. No quantization configuration. Fresh pinned October 27 request confirms the same released text/vision dimensions, without pruning, expert-routing or extra-modality configuration.

sources.title: Asure 12B complete checkpoint index, pinned
sources.evidence: Maps 1065 tensors to five safetensors shards. All indexed tensors were reconciled with bounded headers and the exact configured learned module inventory; index alone was not used as a parameter count.

sources.title: All five Asure 12B bounded shard headers, pinned
sources.evidence: HTTP 206 range requests retrieved only each eight-byte length and bounded JSON header, 143000 bytes total. All 1065 tensors are unpacked BF16 learned weights; every name/shape matches configured modules, offsets are contiguous, tensor byte lengths and complete shard lengths agree. Sum: 12187325040 learned parameters. No packed tensors, scales, stored rotary buffers or duplicate output-head weights.

sources.title: Gemma3 implementation at configured version 4.57.3
sources.evidence: Defines Gemma3 dense attention and MLPs, four layer norms plus Q/K norms per decoder layer, scaled token embedding, final norm, vision tower and multimodal projector. Exact conversion mapping resolves the checkpoint legacy prefixes. LM output shares the token embedding; rotary frequencies and embedding scale are nonpersistent buffers. Projector adds learned 1152x3840 matrix and 1152-dimensional norm.

sources.title: Gemma3 configuration defaults at 4.57.3
sources.evidence: Gemma3TextConfig defaults tie_word_embeddings to true, as used when the exact checkpoint omits that key. Its declared text and vision configurations are instantiated separately.

sources.title: Transformers embedding tying at 4.57.3
sources.evidence: tie_embeddings_and_encoder_decoder consults config.get_text_config(decoder=True).tie_word_embeddings and ties the output to get_input_embeddings. Combined with the exact complete index lacking a separate LM head, establishes counting the shared vocabulary matrix once.

sources.title: SigLIP vision implementation at 4.57.3
sources.evidence: Defines learned patch convolution/bias, position embedding, 27 dense vision layers with attention/MLP biases and layer norms, and final norm. Configured vision_use_head=false excludes pooling-head parameters. Position IDs are nonpersistent buffers.

sources.title: Asure released chat template, pinned
sources.evidence: Formats text/image user content and model responses. No separate reasoning control or tools/schema/assistant function-call/tool-result protocol is defined; their absence does not prove model-wide incapability.

sources.title: Asure public-release announcement
sources.evidence: The author announces that their new Asure model is now available to everyone and links the exact Hugging Face repository. Accessed page structured SocialMediaPosting datePublished is 2026-02-19T15:09:27.935Z. This directly supports February 19 availability, independently of the repository upload date. Fresh October 27 re-read also finds the author describing a linear combination of multiple trained models. This describes a weight merge, not an inference-time multi-model ensemble or expert expansion; the released single dense checkpoint corroborates that interpretation.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 5: Gemma 3 12B Base
sources.evidence: Original Table 5 explicitly identifies the Gemma-3-12B Base column, Architecture Dense, Total Params 12B and Activated Params 12B. This is the Qwen team's rounded comparison convention for its original text evaluation, not a Google active-count disclosure. It directly covers the named Gemma 3 12B base lineage; its active value is not derived here by equating dense total and active parameters. No component scope or exact per-token participation is established.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, Table 18: Gemma 3 12B IT
sources.evidence: Original Table 18 explicitly identifies Gemma-3-12B-IT and gives Activated Params 12B and Total Params 12B. This independently establishes the same nominal comparison convention for the instruction-tuned variant. Asure is not a row in this paper: applying this value to Asure is a documented lineage inference, not a direct Qwen or Trendyol measurement of Asure.

sources.title: Gemma 3 Technical Report, architecture and instruction tuning
sources.evidence: Fresh original report read: Table 1 gives rounded 12B component sizes of 417M vision, 1012M embedding and 10759M non-embedding. Section 2 describes the shared frozen SigLIP vision tower. Section 3 says pretrained models become instruction-tuned through post-training, including teacher distillation and reinforcement-learning fine-tuning; it does not describe a different 12B student architecture. These component counts are not active-parameter counts. Combined with exact PT/IT metadata and Asure config, the report supports retention of nominal size through tuning.

sources.title: Google Gemma 3 12B architecture configuration
sources.evidence: Fresh source read: get_config_for_12b sets 48 layers, width 3840, MLP width 15360, 16 query/8 KV heads, head dimension 256 and a SigLIP tower, matching Asure's core dimensions. Google's native vocabulary has 262144 entries; the Hugging Face release uses padded 262208 entries, already reconciled in the prior exact total. Matching dimensions corroborate the developer-named ancestry and absence of structural resizing; they do not independently prove an active count.

sources.title: Google Gemma SigLIP vision configuration
sources.evidence: Fresh source read: 27 vision layers, width 1152, MLP width 4304, 16 heads and patch size 14 match the retained Asure vision tower. Asure's multimodal ancestry is supported by both its explicit card and its actual configuration, not text-only model-name resemblance.

sources.title: Kimi-VL Technical Report, Table 3: alternative counting convention
sources.evidence: Fresh original Table 3 identifies Gemma3-12B-IT with Act. Params (LLM+VT)=12B+0.4B and Total Params=12B. It is recorded rather than summed into an allegedly precise 12.4B Asure active count; that rounded sum would even exceed the preserved exact complete checkpoint total. Neither table defines phase-dependent execution or an exact per-token count.

parameters_b.note: Exact complete learned count: 12187325040 = 11766034176 language +416866032 vision +4424832 multimodal projector. All five bounded shard headers and 1065 configured names/shapes/dtypes reconcile. Text embedding/output is tied and stored once; no duplicate LM-head tensor. All tensors are unpacked BF16 learned weights and biases; nonpersistent position IDs, rotary frequencies and embedding scale are not counted. The card 12B value is nominal. October 27 parameter re-audit preserves this exact result and freshly corroborates it with the pinned API aggregate; the prior tensor census was not repeated.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 12B active is a lineage inference from Qwen's explicit Activated Params rows for Gemma 3 12B Base (Table 5) and IT (Table 18). Trendyol names Gemma 3-12B as the base, retains its native vision capabilities and describes instruction training; the release author describes a linear weight merge. The released dimensions and unchanged precise checkpoint total corroborate no pruning, added experts or removed vision tower. Google documents PT-to-IT post-training and names the exact PT base in IT metadata, with the same checkpoint total. This is the Qwen team's nominal comparison convention inherited through the documented lineage, not a direct Trendyol/Google active disclosure or an exact every-token census. Dense architecture alone is not used to equate total and active; neither the precise total nor non-embedding subtotal is copied. Kimi-VL's 12B+0.4B LLM+VT row is a different rounded convention, not a more precise replacement. No active component/phase scope is invented; exact modality-dependent participation remains unspecified.

architecture.note: Gemma3 dense decoder-only text Transformer with grouped-query attention, alternating local/full attention, dense gated MLPs, and a dense SigLIP vision encoder/projector. No expert routers are configured or stored.

context_window.note: Exact text max_position_embeddings=131072. This is the released configuration limit, not an independent quality measurement.

modalities.note: Native image-plus-text support is explicit in the card, processor example, vision configuration and complete learned tensor inventory. Outputs are text; no native audio/video branch is declared.

reasoning.note: The exact model documents instruction following and business tasks, without a dedicated reasoning mode or binary capability declaration. Clear baseline false rather than infer incapability from absent controls or transfer sibling T1 reasoning claims.

tool_call.note: No exact-model tool calling declaration or shipped full tool protocol was located. General structured extraction is not function calling; clear unsupported false rather than claim categorical absence.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit preserves the exact 12.18732504B total, freshly corroborated by pinned repository metadata, and establishes nominal 12B active through the documented Gemma 3-12B lineage. Qwen's original Tables 5 and 18 explicitly give 12B activated for Base and IT; the attribution and inference are explicit. Retained text/vision dimensions and Google PT/IT lineage corroborate unchanged nominal architecture. Kimi-VL's separate 12B+0.4B convention is recorded without replacing the chosen nominal value or precise total. Fresh later developer/comparison checks provide no finer active definition. All twelve unrelated assessments and the accepted component breakdown are preserved; no weight shards were downloaded.

parameter_reaudit.method: Re-read the previous report and original pinned card/config; freshly fetched exact API metadata and original Qwen, Kimi-VL and Google reports. Checked the exact later Trendyol distilled-model card, current hosted-provider documentation and the later Gemma 4 original report. Compared Google core/vision architecture definitions and public PT/IT metadata with the released Asure configuration. Preserved the earlier exact tensor reconciliation without repeating it or downloading weights.
parameter_reaudit.access_limitations: Google Hugging Face PT/IT config blob pages were unavailable through the web reader; public official API metadata, original Google implementation and technical report supplied the lineage/architecture corroboration. No gated-weight access was attempted.
parameter_reaudit.outcome: Exact total retained; nominal active 12B recovered as an explicitly attributed lineage inference. No direct Trendyol active disclosure or exact modality/phase-dependent active census was located. Provider/model catalog repeats were not treated as original active-count measurements.
